description: Settings a tenant owns exactly once. Holds the configuration that applies to the whole tenant rather than to a single agent group or user.
comment: Stored by Heimdall as one document, not as a twin on the node. The DTMI identifies the shape of the stored document.

schemas.description: A tier of the tenant's agent topology, e.g. site, area or production line. Names and styles the depth an agent group sits at; it holds no agent groups itself.

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Depth this level sits at below the tenant, 1 to 5.
fields.comment: Explicit rather than the array position. Uniqueness within the tenant is enforced by the API.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Identifier of this level within the tenant's settings. Unique among its siblings.
fields.comment: Never translated - the same reasoning as an agent group's Name: it is the value APIs and configuration refer to. Localized labels belong in DisplayNames.

fields.name: DisplayNames
fields.description: Labels shown for this level, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

fields.name: Descriptions
fields.description: Descriptions of this level, keyed by BCP-47 language tag (e.g. en, de, de-AT).

fields.name: Icon
fields.description: Icon of agent groups on this level, as the key of an icon in the client's icon set (e.g. 'layer', 'factory', 'map-pin', 'conveyor-belt').
fields.comment: The icon's key: lower-case ASCII letters, digits and hyphens, no path separators, dots or spaces ([a-z0-9-]{1,64}). The icon set itself is a client concern.

fields.name: Color
fields.description: Color of agent groups on this level, as a named color token (e.g. 'blue', 'green', 'orange', 'purple').
fields.comment: Named tokens rather than RGB values so the client can map each one to a light and a dark theme variant with guaranteed contrast.

contents.name: AgentGroupLevels
contents.description: Levels of this tenant's agent topology, outermost first.
contents.comment: At most 5 entries, enforced by the API - agent groups occupy levels 1..5, level 6 is where agents sit.
